comment: No source is published. Nine parameters are configured but the widget adds only eight: parameter 2, named Detune Oscillator 1, has no ParamWidget, so it can never be clicked or turned and stays at its default of zero. It is still read, which is what makes the first sawtooth the reference the other three are detuned against. The Frequency knob is configured with a display base of zero, so the tooltip shows the raw -5 to 5 rather than a frequency, while process() raises two to that number and multiplies by 261.6256. The sine takes the V/OCT input but not the Fine Tune knob. Two lights follow the Mode switch and have no positions in the census.
